oracle: Conditional rule: if acknowledged:false means rejection in the central response contract, it cannot establish a confirmed version. This judges serialized outputs outside the product runner.
limits: Injected service response, not a real central failure observed
The formal central ACK response schema and false-value semantics are unavailable, so this oracle cannot confirm a product defect
Empty or version-shaped responses are not used as confirmed counterexamples because their exact response schema is undocumented
